reactions.name: alloy argentan bars from melchior and zinc (5)
reactions.description: A bright copper alloy resembling silver; also called nickel silver. One part copper, one part zinc, further nickel and copper from three parts melchior.

reactions.name: alloy argentan bars from brass and nickel (5)
reactions.description: A bright copper alloy resembling silver; also called nickel silver. One part copper, one part nickel, further zinc and copper from three parts brass.

reactions.name: make coke from anthracite
sponge iron processing
reactions.description: Refine crude sponge iron blooms by hammering and consolidation. Yields mostly low-carbon wrought iron, with some inclusions of steel and cast iron.

reactions.name: make cast/pig iron bars (10)
reactions.description: A high carbon alloy of iron used for sturdy if brittle castings; high-impurity briquettes are called pig iron and used for steelmaking. Made by smelting raw iron with additional coke. Ten parts sponge iron, five parts coke.

reactions.name: make wrought iron bars (1)
reactions.description: A tough, low-carbon iron that is highly malleable when glowing hot. Puddle and fine the brittle cast iron into tough, malleable wrought iron.

reactions.name: make wrought iron bars (5)
reactions.description: A tough, low-carbon iron that is highly malleable when glowing hot. Puddle and fine the brittle cast iron into tough, malleable wrought iron, in bulk.

reactions.name: make steel bars (10)
reactions.description: Mild, low-carbon steel with an excellent toughness-to-affordability ratio. Eight parts wrought iron, two parts cast/pig iron, two parts coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: make damasklilar steel bars (5)
reactions.description: Strong, high-carbon steel with captivating patterns and an excellent edge; also called patternsteel. Three parts steel, two parts pig iron, one part coke, one part lime flux.

reactions.name: make damasklilar steel bars (10)
reactions.description: Strong, high-carbon steel with captivating patterns and an excellent edge; also called patternsteel. Six parts steel, four parts pig iron, two parts coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: make virkel steel bars (10)
reactions.description: "Star-metal" steel. High-alloy, low-carbon steel with meteoric strength; also called starsteel. Three parts steel, four parts ferronickel, two parts ferrocobalt, one part ferromolybdenum, one part coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: make brynonul steel bars (10)
reactions.description: "Bright-mirror" steel. High-alloy, low-carbon steel with that resists rust and acid; also called brightsteel. Four parts steel, three parts ferrochrome, one part wrought iron, one part ferronickel, one part monel, one part coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: make tholduraz steel bars (10)
reactions.description: "Deep-stone" steel. High-alloy tool steel with extreme strength; also called hardsteel. Three parts steel, one part cast iron, two parts ferrotungsten, one part ferrocobalt, one part ferromolybdenum, one part ferrovanadium, one part ferrochrome, two parts coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: make mangaz steel bars (10)
reactions.description: Manganese steel. Medium-carbon alloy steel with notable work-hardening; also called mangalloy steel. Five parts steel, one part cast iron, three parts ferromanganese, one part ferrosilicon, two parts coke, two parts lime flux.

reactions.name: alloy antimonial bronze bars (10)
reactions.description: A primitive bronze with a silver-blue patina. Nine parts copper, one part antimony.

reactions.name: smelt antimonial bronze from antimonide ore
reactions.description: A primitive bronze with a silver-blue patina. Smelt directly from copper antimonide ore.

reactions.name: smelt arsenical bronze from arsenide ore, low temp
reactions.description: A primitive bronze hardened by arsenic. Must smelt directly from copper arsenide ore without overheating.

reactions.name: alloy white bronze bars (10)
reactions.description: A white copper casting alloy. Five parts copper, three parts tin, two parts zinc.

reactions.name: alloy red brass bars (10)
reactions.description: A reddish copper alloy with decent strength and high resistance to salt corrosion. Eight parts copper, one part tin, one part zinc.

reactions.name: alloy latten bars (10)
reactions.description: A cheap, golden mixed copper alloy for common cast goods. Seven parts copper, one part tin, one part zinc, one part lead.

reactions.name: alloy spelter bars (10)
reactions.description: A cheap high-zinc, low-lead alloy that develops a bronze patina. Eight parts zinc, one part lead, one part antimony.

reactions.name: alloy babbitt bars (10)
reactions.description: A lead alloy hardened with antimony and tin. Seven parts lead, two parts antimony, one part tin.

reactions.name: alloy melchior bars (10)
reactions.description: A bright, silvery copper alloy used for coinage and wares; also called cupronickel. Seven parts copper, three parts nickel.

reactions.name: alloy monel bars (10)
reactions.description: A lustrous silver-grey nickel alloy valued for its corrosion resistance and tensile strength. Seven parts nickel, three parts copper.

reactions.name: alloy white gold bars (4)
reactions.description: A cool white 18k gold alloy lightened with palladium and used for sturdy jewelry. Three parts gold, one part palladium.

reactions.name: alloy purple gold bars (5)
reactions.description: A vivid violet gold intermetallic alloy used for fine decorative jewelry. Four parts gold, one part aluminum.

reactions.name: alloy relarkel bars (10)
reactions.description: "King's Metal". A dense, silvery-white platinum alloy boasting extreme hardness and high strength. Seven parts platinum, three parts iridium.

reactions.name: alloy esrelkel bars (5)
reactions.description: "Queen's Metal". A dense, silvery-white platinum alloy boasting high hardness and moderate strength. Four parts platinum, one part silver.

reactions.name: reduce alumina in molten copper to akal bronze bars (10)
reactions.description: A brilliant golden copper alloy with high strength. Melt two parts alumina in solution of two parts cryolite flux in side crucible and introduce with coke reductant to bath of nine parts copper with one part salt cover flux at high heat. Remove dross.

reactions.name: alloy akal bronze bars (10)
reactions.description: A brilliant golden copper alloy with high strength. Nine parts copper, one part aluminum.

reactions.name: alloy akalthas bronze bars (10)
reactions.description: A golden copper alloy with excellent strength. Nine parts akal bronze, one part ferronickel, one part salt cover flux.

reactions.name: alloy akrulthas bronze bars from bronze and monel (10)
reactions.description: A muted golden copper alloy with excellent toughness. Eight parts bronze, two parts monel, one part salt cover flux.

reactions.name: alloy akrulthas bronze bars from bronze, melchior, and nickel (10)
reactions.description: A muted golden copper alloy with excellent toughness. Eight parts bronze, one part melchior, one part nickel, one part salt cover flux.

reactions.name: alloy alacril bars (15)
reactions.description: A silvery cobalt superalloy with exceptional strength. Seven parts cobalt, three parts chromium, two parts nickel, two parts tungsten, one part ferromanganese.

reactions.name: alloy alacril bars (15) with nicoril
reactions.description: A silvery cobalt superalloy with exceptional strength. Five parts cobalt, three parts chromium, four parts nicoril, two parts tungsten, one part ferromanganese.

reactions.name: alloy elgilril bars (15)
reactions.description: A deep silver cobalt superalloy with high fatigue-resistance and elasticity. Seven parts cobalt, three parts chromium, two parts nickel, two parts ferromolybdenum, one part ferromanganese.

reactions.name: alloy elgilril bars (15) with nicoril
reactions.description: A deep silver cobalt superalloy with high fatigue-resistance and elasticity. Five parts cobalt, three parts chromium, four parts nicoril, two parts ferromolybdenum, one part ferromanganese.

reactions.name: alloy nicoril (nickel-cobalt) bars (2)
reactions.description: A grey alloy of cobalt and nickel with moderate strength. One part cobalt, one part nickel.

reactions.name: alloy invarkel bars (5)
reactions.description: A dull grey iron-nickel alloy with moderate strength. Three parts wrought iron, two parts nickel.

reactions.name: alloy conimocril bars (10)
reactions.description: A brilliant silver cobalt-nickel superalloy possessing ultra-high strength. Four parts nickel, three parts cobalt, two parts chromium, one part molybdenum.

reactions.name: alloy conimocril bars with nicoril (10)
reactions.description: A brilliant silver cobalt-nickel superalloy possessing ultra-high strength. Six parts nicoril, one part nickel, two parts chromium, one part molybdenum.

reactions.name: alloy emenril bars (15)
reactions.description: A titanium alloy heat-treatable to immensely high tensile strength and flexibility. Ten parts titanium, two parts vanadium, two parts chromium, one part aluminum.

reactions.name: alloy danmankel bars (10)
reactions.description: A heavy, dark-patinating uranium alloy with extreme density and strength. Eight parts uranium, one part titanium, one part molybdenum.

reactions.name: smelt wrought iron bar from colcothar (1)
smelt copper bar from melacupria (1)
smelt nickel bar from nickelia (1)
smelt manganese bar from mangania (1)
smelt lead bar from plumbic ash (1)
smelt cobalt bar from cobaltia (1)
smelt zinc bar from zinc alba (1)
smelt tin bar from flowers of tin (1)
smelt chromium bar aluminothermically from chromia (2)
make ferrovanadium bars (2)
make ferromolybdenum bars (2)
make ferronickel bars (2)
make ferrocobalt bars (2)
make ferromanganese bars (2)
make ferrotungsten bars (2)
reactions.description: Sinter powdered tungsten into carbon-free wrought iron.

reactions.name: make ferrouranium bars (2)
make ferrochrome bars (2)
smelt poor ferrosilicon bars, carbothermic reduction
reactions.description: A dull, grey master alloy made of three quarters iron and one quarter silicon, used as a deoxidizer. Carbothermically reduce one part silica sand with one part coke in molten bath of parts cast/pig iron under one part lime flux.

reactions.name: concentrate rich ferrosilicon bars, liquation & leaching
reactions.description: A silvery-grey master alloy made of one quarter iron and three quarters silicon, used as a strong deoxidizer. Taking three parts poor ferrosilicon, melt away a third of the iron portion. Leach away a further third of iron as green vitriol using hot oil of vitriol. Collect remaining rich ferrosilicon.

reactions.name: smelt magnesium, silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: A lightweight, silvery-white reactive metal. Silicothermically reduce two parts magnesia using one part rich ferrosilicon in presence of two parts quicklime at high temperature in iron retort furnace.

reactions.name: smelt sodium, carbothermic reduction
reactions.description: A soft, silvery-white alkali metal that burns easily. Carbothermically reduce one part soda ash with one part coke in a retort furnace. Direct condensing fumes of sodium into container of oil.

reactions.name: smelt aluminum, sodiothermic reduction of muriate of soda-alum
reactions.description: A bright, silvery metal prized for its rarity and light weight. Sodiothermically reduce two parts molten muriate of soda-alum and two parts cryolite flux using two parts metallic sodium. Recover salts from dross/slag.

reactions.name: attempt to extract iridium from native platinum with aqua regia
reactions.description: Dissolve native platinum ore in aqua regia. Collect any insoluable iridium from possible trace impurities and work to ingot. Introduce salt of ammon and precipitate dissolved platinum salts. Calcine to sponge platinum mass and work to ingot.

reactions.name: smelt pitchblende to uranium, digestion and magnesiothermic reduction
reactions.description: Sequentially digest pitchblende ore using oil of vitriol, wash with caustic alkali, and calcine to isolate yellocake. React with spirit of fluor to form green salts. Then magnesiothermically reduce at high temperature in sealed crucible/bomb.

reactions.name: smelt pitchblende to ferrouranium, silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Silicothermically reduce pitchblende ore using four parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux. Separate ferrouranium from significant slag.

reactions.name: smelt carnotite to uranium and vanadium, digestion and magnesio- & alumino-thermic reduction
reactions.description: Digest carnotite ore using oil of vitriol. Wash with caustic alkali and remove and calcine the precipitate to isolate yellowcake urania, and react that with spirit of fluor to form green salts. Add salt of ammon to remaining solution to precipitate redcake vanadia and calcine. Separately, aluminothermically reduce vanadia under cover flux and magnesiothermically reduce green salts in sealed crucible, to metallic vanadium and uranium respectively.

reactions.name: smelt carnotite to ferrouranium & ferrovanadium, silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Silicothermically reduce carnotite ore using four parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace. Separate ferrouranium and ferrovandium from significant slag.

reactions.name: smelt wolframite to ferrotungsten and ferromanganese, digestion & silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast wolframite ore with soda ash. Wash cinders with boiling water and set aside residual mud. Introduce spirit of muria to the tungsten wash, then remove the precipitate and add to ammoniacal liquor. Evaporate liquor down and calcine the ammoniacal tungsten crystals to yellow tungstenia powder. Then, silicothermically reduce salts to ferrotungsten powder using two parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace. Recover residual mud and smelt to ferromanganse.

reactions.name: smelt scheelite to ferrotungsten, digestion & silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Digest scheelite ore in hot spirit of muria, stirring frequently, then remove the precipitate and add to ammoniacal liquor. Evaporate liquor down and calcine the ammoniacal tungsten crystals to yellow tungstenia powder. Then, silicothermically reduce tungstenia to ferrotungsten powder using four parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt scheelite to tungsten powder, digestion & aluminothermic reduction
reactions.description: Digest scheelite ore in hot spirit of muria, stirring frequently, then remove the precipitate and add to ammoniacal liquor. Evaporate liquor down and calcine the ammoniacal tungsten crystals to yellow tungstenia powder. Then, aluminothermically reduce tungstenia to tungsten powder using two parts aluminum under a quicklime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt muriate of titan to titanium, magnesiothermic reduction
reactions.description: A white metal with incredible strength-to-weight ratio. Magnesiothermically reduce two parts muriate of titan with two parts magnesium at high heat in retort furnace. Separate salt of magnesia from titanium sponge.

reactions.name: smelt muriate of titan through sodiothermic reduction
reactions.description: A white metal with incredible strength-to-weight ratio. Sodiothermically reduce two parts muriate of titan with two parts metallic sodium at high heat in retort furnace. Separate salt from titanium sponge.

reactions.name: smelt vanadinite to lead & vanadium, alkali roasting & aluminothermic reduction
reactions.description: Sequentially, roast vanadinite ore with soda ash and add the cinders to water. Remove resulting white lead sludge from the solution. Treat solution with salt of ammon to precipitate vanadia salts. Calcine salts to vanadia. Then, aluminothermically reduce vanadia to vanadium using one part aluminum under a quicklime flux in a closed furnace. Recover and smelt white lead sludge.

reactions.name: smelt vanadinite to lead & ferrovanadium, alkali roasting & silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Sequentially, roast vanadinite ore with soda ash and add the cinders to water. Remove resulting white lead sludge from the solution. Treat solution with salt of ammon to precipitate vanadia salts. Calcine salts to vanadia. Then, silicothermically reduce vanadia to ferrovanadium using two parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace. Recover and smelt white lead sludge.

reactions.name: smelt patronite to vanadium, aluminothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast patronite ore to drive off sulfuric fumes. Then, aluminothermically reduce vanadia to vanadium using two parts aluminum under a quicklime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt patronite to ferrovanadium, silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast patronite ore to drive off sulfuric fumes. Then, silicothermically reduce vanadia to ferrovanadium using four parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt molybdenite to molybdenum, aluminothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast molybdenite ore to drive off sulfuric fumes. Then, aluminothermically reduce molybdenia to molybdenum using two parts aluminum under a quicklime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt molybdenite to ferromolybdenum, silicothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast molybdenite ore to drive off sulfuric fumes. Then, silicothermically reduce molybdenia to ferromolybdenum using four parts rich ferrosilicon under a lime flux in a closed furnace.

reactions.name: smelt chromite, chemical processing & aluminothermic reduction
reactions.description: Roast chromite ore with soda ash and add the cinders to water. Remove the resulting hematite sludge. Make solution of chromium salts in oil of vitriol and remove crystals of sulfate of soda. Next, treat solution with green vitriol and precipitate hydrated chromia. Calcine to chromia and aluminothermically reduce the chromia to chromium using one part aluminum with lime flux in a closed furnace. Separately recover and smelt the hematitic and green vitriolic sludges to iron.

reactions.name: smelt ferronickel ores, digestion & carbothermic reduction
reactions.description: Digest iron-nickel ores in spirit of niter. Treat with caustic alkali to precipitate hematite sludge from the nickel liquor. Calcine to nickelia and carbothermically reduce to nickel. Recover and carbothermically reduce hematite sludge to cast iron.

reactions.name: smelt ferromanganese ores, digestion & carbothermic reduction
reactions.description: Digest iron-manganese ores in spirit of niter and calcine. Add the crystals to caustic alkali to precipitate hematite sludge from the manganese liquor. Calcine to mangania and carbothermically reduce to manganese. Recover and carbothermically reduce hematite sludge to cast iron.

reactions.name: slake caustic soda from powder
reactions.description: Slake soda ash and quicklime together to begin causticization reaction. Remove precipitated lime from caustic soda.

reactions.name: slake bulk caustic soda from mineral
reactions.description: Slake natron or trona and four parts quicklime together to begin bulk causticization reaction. Remove precipitated lime from caustic soda.

reactions.name: make soap from oil (caustic soda)
make fertilizer from any alkali sulfates (as potash)
make fertilizer from langbeinite alkali sulfates (as potash)
make fertilizer from polyhalite alkali sulfates (as potash)
make fertilizer from kainite alkali sulfates (as potash)
make fertilizer from sulfate of potash (as potash)
make fertilizer from ammoniacal vitriol (as potash)
dry-distill any vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat powdered vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual oxide powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill green vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat green vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual colcothar powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill blue vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat blue vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual melacupria powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill white vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat white vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual zinc alba powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill nickel vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat nickel vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual nickelia powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill red vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat red vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual cobaltia powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill pink vitriol to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat pink vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual mangania powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill alum to oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat alum in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into oil of vitriol. Residual alumina and sulfate of potash powders are retrieved.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize brimstone into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast brimstone in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize any sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast sulfide ore in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and metal oxide powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize iron sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast iron sulfide ore such as marcasite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and colcothar powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize copper sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast copper sulfide (no arsenides) ore such as covellite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and melacupria powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize chalcopyrite ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast chalcocite ore in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate, colcothar, and melacupria powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize pentlandite ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast pentlandite ore in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate, colcothar, and nickelia powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize zinc sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast zinc sulfide ore such as sphalerite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and zinc alba powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize cobalt sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast cobalt sulfide (no arsenides) ore such as cattierite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and cobaltia powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize nickel sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast nickel sulfide ore such as millerite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and nickelia powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: roast, oxidize manganese sulfide ore into oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Roast manganese sulfide ore such as alabandite in presence of saltpeter. Pass sulfuric flue gases through leaden chamber and collect oil of vitriol. Residual sulfate and mangania powders are retrieved from cinders.

reactions.name: dry-distill any saltpeter and any vitriol to spirit of niter
reactions.description: Heat saltpeter with vitriol in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into spirit of niter. Residual sulfate and oxide powders are retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill potash saltpeter and alum to spirit of niter
reactions.description: Heat potash saltpeter with alum in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into spirit of niter. Residual sulfate of potash powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill potash saltpeter and bisulfate to spirit of niter
reactions.description: Heat potash saltpeter with bisulfate of potash in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into spirit of niter. Residual sulfate of potash powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: dry-distill soda saltpeter and bisulfate to spirit of niter
reactions.description: Heat saltpeter with bisulfate of soda in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into spirit of niter. Residual sulfate of soda powder is retrieved.

reactions.name: spirit of fluor, distill fluor lapis and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Dissolve two parts fluor lapis powder into one part oil of vitriol in nickel or noble metal container to create two parts spirit of fluor. Remove precipitated gypsum powder.

reactions.name: spirit of niter, low-heat distill any saltpeter and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat saltpeter and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of niter. Retrieve the bisulfate residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of niter, low-heat distill soda saltpeter and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat saltpeter and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of niter. Retrieve the bisulfate of soda residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of niter, low-heat distill potash saltpeter and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat potash saltpeter and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of niter. Retrieve the bisulfate of potash residual powder.

reactions.name: aqua regia, mix spirits of niter and muria
reactions.description: Mix one part spirit of muria and one part spirit of fluor into two parts aqua regia in glass container.

reactions.name: recycle mangania from muriate of manganese with milk of lime
reactions.description: Heat solution of muriate of manganese and milk of lime. Remove precipitated mangania. Evaporate to recover salt of calcia.

reactions.name: dry distill hartshorn from antlers/horns
reactions.description: Heat horn material in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into deposit as hartshorn powder.

reactions.name: dry distill bulk hartshorn from antlers/horns
reactions.description: Heat horn material in retort to dry-distill. Off-gases condense into deposit as hartshorn powder.

reactions.name: distill ammoniacal liquor from quicklime and hartshorn
reactions.description: Gently heat wet mixture of hartshorn and quicklime in retort to distill. Off-gases bubble through cold water, becoming ammoniacal liquor. Collect residual lime.

reactions.name: distill ammoniacal liquor from lime and salt of ammon
reactions.description: Gently heat solution of salt of ammon and milk of lime in retort to distill. Off-gases bubble through cold water, becoming ammoniacal liquor. Collect residual salt of calcia.

reactions.name: distill ammoniacal liquor from lime and ammoniacal vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat solution of ammoniacal vitriol and milk of lime in retort to distill. Off-gases bubble through cold water, becoming ammoniacal liquor. Collect residual gypsum powder.

reactions.name: carbochlorinate alumina to muriate of soda-alum
reactions.description: React spirit of muria with mangania to generate chlorine gas in situ, passing through dessicamt salt of calcia to dry. Pass gas through a hot charge of alumina, carbon, and salt to form muriate of soda-alum. Retrieve residual muriate of manganese and recycle salt of calcia.

reactions.name: carbochlorinate titania to muriate of titan
reactions.description: React spirit of muria with mangania to generate chlorine gas in situ, passing through dessicamt salt of calcia to dry. Pass gas through a hot charge of titania and carbon to form muriate of titan. Retrieve residual muriate of manganese and recycle salt of calcia.

reactions.name: process beryls to flowers of beryl-alum
reactions.description: Digest ground beryl in hot caustic soda and leach. Remove remaining slag. React the leachate with spirit of fluor and dehydrate, recovering flowers of beryl-alum.

reactions.name: digest ilmenite with oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Digest two ground ilmenite ore in two parts hot oil of vitriol. Quench and precipitate titania. Collect liquor and dehydrate to green vitriol.

reactions.name: make soda ash from sulfate of soda, carbon, and lime
reactions.description: Leblanc Process. Roast sulfate of soda with lime and carbon. Leach soda ash from resulting black ash. Remove remainder galligu (as slag).

reactions.name: make potash from sulfate of potash, carbon, and lime
reactions.description: Leblanc Process. Roast sulfate of potash with lime and carbon. Leach potash from resulting black ash. Remove remainder galligu (as slag).

reactions.name: bulk produce soda ash from sulfate of soda, carbon, and lime
reactions.description: Leblanc Process. Roast sulfate of soda with lime and carbon. Leach soda ash from resulting black ash. Remove remainder galligu (as slag).

reactions.name: bulk produce potash from sulfate of potash, carbon, and lime
reactions.description: Leblanc Process. Roast sulfate of potash with lime and carbon. Leach potash from resulting black ash. Remove remainder galligu (as slag).

reactions.name: make soda ash and salt of ammon from salt and ammoniacal liquor
reactions.description: Drip spirit of muria onto powdered lime in retort and bubble gases through solution of commmon salt in ammoniacal liquor. Collect precipitate from solution and calcine at low heat to soda ash. Evaporate and filter crystals of salt of ammon from the solution. Recover salt of calcia from retort.

reactions.name: potash saltpeter, mix calcic saltpeter & potash salt
reactions.description: Dissolve calcic saltpeter and potash salt in hot water. Cool, crystallize, and recover saltpeter. Evaporate to recover salt of calcia.

reactions.name: potash saltpeter, mix magnesiac saltpeter & potash salt
reactions.description: Dissolve magnesiac saltpeter and potash salt in hot water. Cool, crystallize, and recover saltpeter. Evaporate to recover salt of magnesia.

reactions.name: soda saltpeter, mix calcic saltpeter & soda ash
reactions.description: Dissolve calcic saltpeter and soda ash in hot water. Precipitate and remove lime. Evaporate to recover soda saltpeter.

reactions.name: soda saltpeter, mix magnesiac saltpeter & soda ash
reactions.description: Dissolve magnesiac saltpeter and soda ash in hot water. Precipitate and remove magnesia alba. Evaporate to recover soda saltpeter.

reactions.name: potash saltpeter, mix calcic saltpeter & potash
reactions.description: Dissolve calcic saltpeter and potash in hot water. Precipitate and remove lime. Cool to crystallize and recover saltpeter.

reactions.name: potash saltpeter, mix magnesiac saltpeter & potash
reactions.description: Dissolve magnesiac saltpeter and potash in hot water. Precipitate and remove magnesia alba. Cool to crystallize and recover saltpeter.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, distill salt and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat solution of salt and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the bisulfate of soda residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, dry-distill salt and bisulfate
reactions.description: Heat powdered mixture of salt and bisulfate of soda in retort to dry-distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the sulfate of soda residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, distill potash salt and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat solution of potash salt and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the bisulfate of potash residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, distill potash salt and bisulfate
reactions.description: Heat powdered mixture of potash salt and bisulfate of potash in retort to dry-distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the sulfate of potash residual powder.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, distill calcia salt and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Heat solution of salt of calcia and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the residual gypsum powder.

reactions.name: spirit of muria, distill ammon and magnesia salts and oil of vitriol
reactions.description: Gently heat solution of salt of magnesia, salt of ammon, and oil of vitriol to distill off spirit of muria. Retrieve the residual sulfate of magnesia and ammoniacal vitriol powders.
